core.description: Global core settings for ConnMan behavior

IgnoredInterfaces.description: List of network interfaces (e.g., 'eth0', 'virbr0') that ConnMan should ignore. Set to ['any'] to disable all interface management.

OfflineMode.description: Start ConnMan in offline mode (no external network access). Useful for maintenance or air-gapped systems.

TechnologyOrder.description: Preferred order of network technologies (e.g., ['wifi', 'ethernet']). Higher-priority technologies are selected when multiple are available.

ManualConnect.description: Disable automatic reconnection attempts. Connections must be explicitly initiated by the user or app.

AutoConnect.description: Automatically reconnect to previously used networks when in range.

AutoConnectEnabled.description: Allow Wi-Fi networks to be automatically connected (only effective when AutoConnect is true).

Enabled.description: Enable or disable the Wi-Fi radio globally.

PowerSaving.description: Enable power-saving mode (e.g., suspend Wi-Fi scanning when idle). May delay reconnection.

RandomizeMAC.description: Use randomized MAC addresses for scanning and connecting. Improves privacy, but may break MAC-based network policies.

WFD.description: Enable Wi-Fi Direct support for peer-to-peer connections.

Enabled.description: Enable or disable the Ethernet technology globally.

Enable.description: Automatically enter offline mode when no known networks are reachable.

proxysvc.description: System proxy service settings (transparent HTTP proxy support)

Enabled.description: Enable the system proxy service (used by proxy-aware applications).

PAC.description: Enable support for Proxy Auto-Configuration (PAC) files.
